Discover Weather Radar Widgets on your iPhone and iPad. Watch for the rain with live radar view, updating every 10 minutes. You can add both small and big widgets and also view the radar inside the app.  

New in iOS 17 - refresh widgets with a refresh button to keep them up to date.

Protect your privacy - the app doesn't have access to your location by default and only asks for approximate location when you enable "Current Location" option. We do not share or save your location to our server.
